from mistune.toc import render_toc_ul def test_ac_fr_002_1(): """AC-FR-002-1: Given toc = [(1, 'intro', 'Introduction')], when render_toc_ul(toc, ordered=True), render ordered TOC with
    wrapper.""" toc = [(1, 'intro', 'Introduction')] assert render_toc_ul(toc, ordered=True) == '
      \n
    1. Introduction
      2. \n
    \n' def test_ac_fr_002_2(): """AC-FR-002-2: Given toc = [(1, 'a', 'A'), (2, 'b', 'B')], when render_toc_ul(toc, ordered=True), render nested ordered TOC.""" toc = [(1, 'a', 'A'), (2, 'b', 'B')] assert render_toc_ul(toc, ordered=True) == '
      \n
    1. A\n
        \n
      1. B
        2. \n
      \n
      2. \n
    \n' def test_ac_fr_002_3(): """AC-FR-002-3: Given toc = [(1, 'a', 'A'), (2, 'b', 'B'), (1, 'c', 'C')], when render_toc_ul(toc, ordered=True), render mixed nested and flat ordered TOC items.""" toc = [(1, 'a', 'A'), (2, 'b', 'B'), (1, 'c', 'C')] assert render_toc_ul(toc, ordered=True) == '
      \n
    1. A\n
        \n
      1. B
        2. \n
      \n
      2. \n
    2. C
      3. \n
    \n'
